module: Flowgraph node "Mission Control Hints" (category repeat_instant, author BeamNG, duration): displays control hints (shift gear, clutch, horn, etc.) in the Mission Controls HUD app (ui_apps_missionControls). Input "reset" (pulse that clears everything). For each hint i ("Hint Count"): "action_i" (input action with templates shiftUp, shiftDown, clutch, throttle, brake, parkingbrake, horn), "uiEvent_i" (UI navigation event, hidden), "label_i" (text or translation key).
notes: Without an action or uiEvent, the hint is cleared (category flowgraph_<id>_<i>).

postInit.desc: Creates the pins and loads the ui_apps_missionControls extension.

updatePins.desc: Adjusts the number of pin trios (action, uiEvent, label).

work.desc: Loads the extension if needed, clears if reset, otherwise sends or clears each hint via setControl.
